title: Photograph with Dr. Bechet in 1935
summary: Russell and Laurent discuss the large picture of Laurent with Dr. Bechet, taken in the dentist's parlor.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, I think of it. I want to ask about these pictures that we are returning. If you remember just about when they were taken, the one big picture is with you and Dr. Bechet.
Yeah. This was taken around in 1935. This was taken around in 1935.
Was that over at his little home there where he had his dentist's office?
Yeah. It was taken right in the parlor. The parlor was here and the dining room was there. We were standing in the dining room and they snapped from in the parlor.
Oh, yes. You had a band there at that time?
Oh, yeah. We was just discussing certain little matters.
